data.name: Myths of Switzerland
data.detailed_description:
Myths of Switzerland is a narrative-driven survival horror game that plunges you into the dark heart of forgotten folklore. Play as Alice and Felix, two unsuspecting travelers who got struck by an evil old curse, stumble into a world full of unimaginable horrors.

Through an freed ancient evil the Land of Switzerland unravels into a descent through madness, as twisted legends from Swiss mythology come to life around you. From shapeshifting spirits in the woods to the haunting cries of the Tatzelwurm, or the crunching of bones and flesh from the Chindlifrässer .

Features:

  • Local Cooperative Gameplay: Play as Alice and Felix and work together to solve environmental puzzles, uncover secrets, and survive encounters with supernatural horrors.

  • Folklore-Based Horror: Encounter terrifying creatures and scenarios inspired by authentic Swiss myths, reimagined with a dark, psychological twist.

  • Atmospheric Exploration: Traverse misty forests, abandoned chalets, icy caverns, and cursed chapels—all rendered in haunting detail, enabled by the Unreal Engine 5

  • Uncover the Truth: Piece together a deeply layered narrative through found notes, environmental storytelling, and the meeting of old Friends.

  • Flight: There is no Fight, no hope, all you want is to escape this cursed land

  • Eerie Soundscape: An original soundtrack and immersive sound design bring the Swiss' chilling ambiance to life.

Will you unravel the secrets behind these age-old myths, or become just another tale whispered in the dark?

data.short_description: Myths of Switzerland is a survival horror adventure where you play as Alice and Felix, trapped in a nightmarish world twisted by ancient Swiss folklore. Face the unimaginable, uncover forgotten legends, and survive the terrifying myths that were never meant to be remembered. Will you Survive ?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
